description: Les horaires des voyages des Bus de SRTGN is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Société régionale de transport de Gouvernorat de Nabeul (SRTGN). Ce jeux de données présente les horaires des voyages des bus de SRTGN pour toutes les saisons; été, hiver et la saison de Ramadhan. En outre ça détaille les horaires de départ, la durée de voyage et la station d'arrivée ainsi que les jours de service de chaque voyage et les jours de repos. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Société régionale de transport de Gouvernorat de Nabeul (SRTGN). It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
